CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash.en: The ATTACK stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLASH outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash.fr: La stat ATTAQUE de tous tes\nPOKéMON augmente un peu.\pIl permet aussi d'utiliser la\ncapacité FLASH hors combat.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazi.en: Only skilled TRAINERS can collect\nPOKéMON BADGES.\pI see you have at least one.\pThose BADGES have amazing secrets,\ndid you know?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazi.fr: Seuls les DRESSEURS talentueux\npeuvent collecter des BADGES\pPOKéMON.\pJe vois que tu en as au moins un.\pCes BADGES ont des secrets\nétonnants, tu savais ?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytim.en: Come visit me anytime you wish.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytim.fr: Viens me voir quand tu veux.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf.en: The DEFENSE stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nSURF outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf.fr: La stat DÉFENSE de tous tes\nPOKéMON augmente un peu.\pIl permet aussi d'utiliser la\ncapacité SURF hors combat.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBa.en: Now then…\pWhich of the eight BADGES should\nI describe?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut.en:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
CUT outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut.fr:
Les POKéMON jusqu'au Niv. 30
t'obéissent.\pMême les étrangers reçus par
échange.\pLes POKéMON de niveau supérieur
seront rebelles en combat.\pIl permet aussi d'utiliser la
capacité COUPE hors combat.
